# Dazzle Divas Cleaning LLC

> Professional vacation rental turnover and residential cleaning service based in Volusia County, Florida. Licensed, insured, and family-operated since 2018. Trusted by Airbnb hosts, VRBO owners, property managers, and homeowners across Daytona Beach, Ormond Beach, Ormond-by-the-Sea, New Smyrna Beach, Port Orange, Daytona Beach Shores, and Ponce Inlet.

## Services

Each service has a dedicated detail page with pricing, process, FAQ, and full schema:

- **Vacation Rental Turnover Cleaning** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/services/vacation-rental-turnover
  Fast, reliable turnover cleaning for Airbnb, VRBO, and short-term rental hosts. 2–4 hour average turnover. 30-point photo verification. 550+ properties cleaned a year. Pricing by bedroom count: $100–140 (studio/1BR), $140–200 (2BR), $200–280 (3BR+).

- **Emergency / Same-Day Cleaning** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/services/emergency-cleaning
  24/7 emergency response for vacation rentals. 2-hour dispatch goal during business hours. No rush fees, no weekend or holiday surcharge on standard tiers. Handles surprise bookings, no-show cleaners, post-storm recovery, inspection prep.

- **Property Management Cleaning** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/services/property-management
  Multi-property cleaning service for hosts and managers running 3 to 50+ vacation rentals. Volume pricing tiers: 10% off (Starter, 3–5 properties), 15% off + dedicated manager (Pro, 6–15 properties), Custom (Enterprise, 16+). Includes calendar sync (Airbnb, VRBO, Hospitable, Guesty, Vacasa) and monthly reporting.

- **Residential House Cleaning** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/services/residential-house-cleaning
  Weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and one-time cleaning for Volusia County homeowners, second-home owners, and snowbirds, plus move-in/move-out. Custom quote within 24 hours.

- **Deep Cleaning** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/services/deep-cleaning
  Top-to-bottom detailed clean: baseboards, ceiling fans, grout, inside cabinets and appliances. For season openings, post-renovation, after long stays, and before listing photos. Custom quote within 24 hours.

- **Eco-Friendly Cleaning** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/services/eco-friendly-cleaning
  Non-toxic, fragrance-conscious products on request with any service, chosen with guests, kids, and pets in mind. Same checklist and photo verification. Custom quote within 24 hours.

## Pricing

Published prices are at https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/pricing. Vacation rental turnovers by bedroom count: $100–140 (studio/1BR), $140–200 (2BR), $200–280 (3BR+); 4+BR and luxury properties are custom-quoted. Property-management volume tiers: 10% off (3–5 properties), 15% off plus a dedicated manager (6–15), custom (16+). No rush fees and no weekend or holiday surcharge on standard tiers. Residential, deep, eco-friendly, and move-in/move-out cleaning are custom-quoted within 24 hours.

## Service Area

Dazzle Divas Cleaning serves all of Volusia County, Florida. Seven communities have dedicated landing pages with neighborhood-level coverage detail, local context, and area-specific FAQ:

- **Ormond Beach** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/cleaning/ormond-beach
  Includes Ormond-by-the-Sea, Ocean Shore Boulevard corridor, Granada Boulevard, Halifax Plantation, The Trails, Tomoka Estates, Plantation Pines, Riverside Drive. Snowbird-season specialty (October–April).

- **Daytona Beach** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/cleaning/daytona-beach
  Includes North Atlantic Avenue, Daytona Beach Shores, South Peninsula, Beachside, Wilbur-by-the-Sea, Pelican Bay, Indigo Lakes, Halifax Plantation. Race-week capacity reserved (Speedweeks, Bike Week, Biketoberfest, Daytona 500).

- **New Smyrna Beach** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/cleaning/new-smyrna-beach
  Includes Flagler Avenue, North Beach, Bethune Beach, Canal District, Coronado Island, Mary Avenue, Smyrna Dunes. Boutique vacation rental focus, surf-tourism aware.

- **Daytona Beach Shores** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/cleaning/daytona-beach-shores
  Separate city on the barrier island south of Daytona Beach. Condo-tower turnovers planned around front-desk keys, elevators, and loading zones, from Frank Rendon Park to Sunglow Pier.

- **Ormond-by-the-Sea** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/cleaning/ormond-by-the-sea
  Unincorporated coastal community north of Ormond Beach along A1A to the Flagler County line. Beach houses and small condos, snowbird and family long stays, same crew grid as Ormond Beach.

- **Port Orange** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/cleaning/port-orange
  Mainland city south of Daytona Beach. Turnovers and home cleaning for rentals and second homes from the Spruce Creek Fly-In to the Halifax riverfront, by crews that also work the beachside.

- **Ponce Inlet** — https://www.dazzledivascleaning.com/cleaning/ponce-inlet
  Town at the southern tip of the peninsula. Oceanfront condos and riverfront homes near the lighthouse, Inlet Harbor, and Lighthouse Point Park.

Surrounding Volusia County communities are served on request.
